overview_description.description:
Health-tech 

Hiba Health is a pioneering digital health platform dedicated to transforming weight management and combating obesity-related diseases, including type 2 diabetes. Leveraging advanced artificial intelligence, Hiba Health empowers individuals through education and behavioral change, enabling them to adopt healthier lifestyles and create personalized meal plans. The platform uniquely integrates GLP-1 medications such as Ozempic and Mounjaro with telehealth services and gamification features, providing a comprehensive and engaging approach to health improvement.

Founded by experienced entrepreneur Hiba Elchaki, Hiba Health is tailored to the cultural and dietary needs of the Saudi Arabian market, aligning with the nation's Vision 2030 healthcare innovation goals. By focusing on both mental and physical well-being, Hiba Health addresses the underlying factors of eating disorders and promotes sustainable health transformations. Committed to making quality mental and physical health support accessible and effective, Hiba Health aims to foster a healthier and more empowered community.

product.name: Diabetes Management & Reversal Program
product.description: A program designed to restore normal glucose levels and reduce HbA1c below 6.5, aiming to stop diabetes-related medications for type 2 diabetes patients.

product.name: Mental Health Management Service
product.description: A service providing mental health assessment and psychotherapy techniques to improve psychological well-being alongside physical health management.

product.name: Personal Health Coaching
product.description: A service matching users with health coaches who provide peer support, practical advice, and accountability to help achieve health goals.

identifier.value: Real-Time Glucose Monitoring and Immediate Medical Consultation

product.name: Real-Time Glucose Monitoring and Immediate Medical Consultation
product.description: A system that monitors glucose levels in real time and provides immediate medical advice to maintain glucose control during fluctuations.

product.name: Self-Care Planning and Support
product.description: A service that helps users create and follow personalized self-care plans focusing on nutrition, physical activity, and mental health.
